businessScope.basis: documented legacy fallback; no department targeting
businessScope.output: Grounded multilingual service-quality summary and proposed improvements for manager review.

architecture.pattern: 02 Sequential / Pipeline; application-hosted deterministic stages and one Foundry prompt agent
architecture.hosting: .NET 10 Razor Pages and colocated worker; Linux App Service B1 x1, Always On
architecture.storage: StorageV2 Standard_LRS Hot; private raw, processed, status and audit containers; ingest and poison queues
architecture.foundry: Basic AIServices S0 account and direct child project; Microsoft-managed agent state
architecture.network: Preserve proposed public TLS endpoints with private blob containers; no private-network approval inferred
architecture.identity: User-assigned managed identity for runtime Storage and Foundry; Entra JWT API policy unchanged

installationDependencies.proposedIdentityObjects: Dedicated scenario-owned API and operator public-client registrations unless approved reusable inputs are supplied.
installationDependencies.proposedTokenPath: Microsoft-library authorization-code/PKCE operator acquisition; existing UI passes token in memory to JWT APIs.
installationDependencies.apiPolicy: v2 tenant/audience validation, operator oid allowlist, access_as_user or existing Feedback.Operator validation branch
installationDependencies.directoryScope: Registration/service-principal creation, exposed delegated scope, approved redirects and any required delegated consent must be explicitly authorized; no broad Graph grants or automatic app-role caller assignment.
installationDependencies.outputCapture: Capture real tenant/application/client/object/scope IDs automatically; generated identity IDs are installation outputs.
installationDependencies.ownership: Use stable scenario ownership markers and verify owned objects before reuse; names alone are insufficient.
installationDependencies.ordering: Prepare idempotent identity setup and azd hooks after design confirmation; identity outputs, dependent provisioning, app publication, agent readiness, fixtures, acceptance.
installationDependencies.dependentChecks: Final-audience ARM what-if and live authenticated API checks depend on real identity outputs; never deploy preview-only audience.
installationDependencies.permissionStatus: No current cloud/directory authorization; actual tenant capabilities unknown; no administrator requirement assumed.

limitations: Historical target and conditional authorization are not imported into current portal authorization.

planningCost.basis: Historical 2026-10-22 public B1 quote and low-volume allowance; not a refreshed deployment estimate.
planningCost.additionalCharges: Model tokens, Storage transactions/retention and possible egress; applicable identity licensing not assessed.
planningCost.requiredReview: Refresh complete costs and model workload estimate during separately authorized preparation before deployment consent.

officialIdentityEvidence.finding: Default member registration rights differ from guest access and can be restricted; no tenant-specific capability inferred.
Use a supported Microsoft authentication library and authorization-code/PKCE; exact redirect/client configuration must be validated.

nextBoundary: Portal design confirmation only; not cloud preparation, directory installation, deployment or suitability approval.
